$comment: Content of the README pictures. Cards: node sh1ft-w.github.io/theme/v1/readme-images/render.mjs <this repo> cards. The title image is NOT rendered from here: docs/images/readme-title.webp is a finished AI-generated image (free to use, metadata removed), used unchanged for light and dark. docs/images/stage-photo.jpg is its photo part for the website hero. docs/readme-title.html is a template to rebuild the title from the photo if needed.

title.name: Chihiros
title.sub: Chihiros LED lamps and the dosing pump in Home Assistant: every channel as a slider, daily schedules written to the lamp, dosing that is never repeated. No app, no cloud.

new.title: All 0x5A lamps
new.text: A II, WRGB II, Pro and Slim, VIVID III, Universal WRGB, SEA_LED, Terrarium Egg, Z Light TINY and Commander 1, 4 and X, detected by their Bluetooth name.

new.title: 1 to 4 channels
new.text: Brightness, RGB or RGBW, as the lamp has them. Sliders, set_channels and schedules follow the channels of each model.

new.title: VIVID III fan
new.text: Fan speed or automatic by temperature, plus fan speed and temperature sensors.

new.title: Calendar versions
new.text: Year, month and the release of that month: 26.10.3 is the third release of October 2026.

features.title: Every channel a slider
features.text: Red, green, blue, white or warm white from 0 to 100 %, like in the app, plus the service set_channels.

features.title: A light with transitions
features.text: Brightness keeps the mix, transition fades in gentle steps, switching on brings back the last mix instead of 100 % white.

features.title: Schedules in the lamp
features.text: Daily curves and weekday schedules are written to the lamp, which then runs them by itself, even without Home Assistant.

features.title: Sun, feeding, acclimatization
features.text: A schedule after the real sun, a feeding light button and a dimmed start for new tanks.

features.title: Dosing pump
features.text: Dose, calibrate and program 1 to 8 channels. Counters from the pump, container level and a push when it runs low.

features.title: Never doses twice
features.text: A dose is never repeated automatically: rather an error message than a double dose.

features.title: Never blocks the start
features.text: First contact runs in the background after Home Assistant has started.

features.title: Kind to Bluetooth proxies
features.text: One connection at a time, a hard time limit and disconnect after 15 seconds idle, so other devices get their slot.

entities.title: Light
entities.text: One light per lamp: brightness, RGB or RGBW with transition. Attribute channels shows every channel in %.

entities.title: Channel numbers
entities.text: red, green, blue, white or warm per model, plus feeding light duration, sun ramp and acclimatization.

entities.title: Switches and select
entities.text: auto_mode, sun cycle and acclimatization, scene (RGB lamps), sun earliest and latest as times.

entities.title: Fan (VIVID III)
entities.text: fan with speed and automatic mode, fan_rpm and fan_temperature_celsius.

entities.title: Dosing pump
entities.text: Per channel: dose button and volume, today, total, remaining, lasts, program, active and catch up switches.

entities.title: Diagnostics
entities.text: reachable with the last error, signal strength, last contact, firmware and a diagnostics download.

items.title: One connection
items.text: Over Home Assistant's Bluetooth or ESPHome proxies, a lock per device, disconnected after 15 seconds idle.

items.title: The app's frames
items.text: Channel levels, modes, schedule points and dosing commands, exactly as the My Chihiros app sends them.

items.title: Remembers what you set
items.text: The lamp does not report its colour. Home Assistant keeps the last state and restores it after a power cut.
